control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 30 %, check obstacle left, then obstacle right, else drive in the dark; if the light is not below 30 %, drive in the dark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward; else stop at a wall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle, stop; else follow the line.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through the tunnel without hitting its walls.
